summary: Adds multiple line items to a material requirements document.
description:
Adds up to 100 line items to an existing material requirements document in Draft, Ready for Review or Final status.
Either all line items are added or none are; if any line item is invalid, the request fails and nothing is saved.
Line numbers are assigned in request order, starting after the highest line number on the document.
Each quantity cannot be negative and defaults to 0 when omitted. When required_at is omitted, the document's required on-site date is used.
Only Admin users can add line items to a Final document.

schema.description: Class representing a procore response with data.
API request model for bulk creating material requirements line items.

items.description: Creates material requirements lines from a collection of material catalog items.
API request model for a material requirements line item created from a material catalog item.

item_id.description: Material catalog item ID to create the line from.

quantity.description: Quantity of material needed for the line. Cannot be negative. Defaults to 0 when omitted.

required_at.description: Required on-site date for the line. Defaults to the document's required on-site date when omitted.
